questions.question: Zacchaeus, a tax collector in Jericho, was too small to see Jesus over the crowd. What did he do?

answers.text: Ran ahead and climbed a tree
Pushed his way to the front
Asked the crowd to let him through

questions.question: Jesus saw Zacchaeus up in a tree and told him to hurry down. What reason did Jesus give?

answers.text: He must stay at his house today
The crowd was about to block the road
He had a message for all of Jericho

questions.question: Zacchaeus, a wealthy tax collector, told Jesus he would give what part of his possessions to the poor?
After Zacchaeus welcomed Him, Jesus said the Son of Man came to seek and to save whom?
